title: Day trip on Quebec Historic Road, Chemin du Roy (Montreal to Trois-Rivières)
blurb: Discover the treasures of the oldest road in Quebec provance, Chemin du Roy (King's road). Established during the New France era. This day trip covers the part of road between Montreal and Trois-Rivières only. Admire the Architectural and industrial heritage of the small towns along the road. See one of the most beautiful small towns downtown in the province of Quebec. Visit Trois-Reviere, the 2nd oldest city in Canada and see both its old parts and popular downtown. Visit Canada’s National Shrine to Our Blessed Mother.
